description: This file defines the implementation of the IUidObserver interface in Android's binder IPC mechanism, including the BpUidObserver proxy class, the onTransact method for handling IPC calls, and related transaction codes.

classes.name: BpUidObserver
classes.description: Proxy class implementing IUidObserver interface for IPC communication.

methods.name: onUidGone
methods.description: Notifies that a UID is gone.

methods.name: onUidActive
methods.description: Notifies that a UID is active.

methods.name: onUidIdle
methods.description: Notifies that a UID is idle.

methods.name: onUidStateChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a UID's state has changed.

methods.name: onUidProcAdjChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a UID's process adjustment has changed.
